systems.tiers: national; enrolment records civil status details, photograph and fingerprints; automatic registration at 18 for those enrolled for the NIP; deceased voters struck off on the death certificate, of which the competent administrative authority must send a copy to the ministry within fifteen days

note: The electoral code (law of 19 January 2025): birth certificates, supplementary judgments and death certificates appear only as supporting documents for the electoral roll, an electoral register (out of scope under the typology's land class). The death-certificate copy sent to the Interior ministry is a paper transmission, not a system. No fact.
